SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_board B WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( B.BOARD_SJ LIKE '%' || #{searchRequest.keyword} || '%' OR B.BOARD_CN LIKE '%' || #{searchRequest.keyword} || '%' )
AND TRIM(B.DEPT_CD) = TRIM(#{deptCd})
AND B.BOARD_TYPE_CD = #{boardTypeCd}

SELECT BOARD_ID ,BOARD_TYPE_CD ,BOARD_SJ ,BOARD_CN ,FRST_RGTR_ID ,FRST_REG_DT ,LAST_MDFR_DT ,BOARD_ATCH_FILE_ID ,TRIM(DEPT_CD) AS DEPT_CD ,PROJ_ID ,IMPRTNT_YN ,CMNT_USE_YN ,VIEW_CNT FROM tb_board B WHERE 1 = 1
AND TRIM(B.DEPT_CD) = TRIM(#{deptCd})
AND B.BOARD_TYPE_CD = #{boardTypeCd}
AND (B.BOARD_SJ LIKE '%'|| #{searchRequest.keyword} || '%' OR B.BOARD_CN LIKE '%'|| #{searchRequest.keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY B.BOARD_ID DESC
OFFSET #{getOffset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{getPageSize} ROWS ONLY

SELECT DISTINCT B.BOARD_TYPE_CD AS boardTypeCd, TRIM(B.DEPT_CD) AS deptCd, CASE WHEN B.BOARD_TYPE_CD = 'FREE' THEN '자유게시판' WHEN B.BOARD_TYPE_CD = 'ANON' THEN '익명게시판' WHEN B.BOARD_TYPE_CD = 'NOTICE' THEN '공지사항' WHEN B.BOARD_TYPE_CD = 'DEPT' THEN D.DEPT_NM
ELSE B.BOARD_SJ END AS boardName FROM tb_board B
LEFT JOIN tb_department D ON TRIM(B.DEPT_CD) = TRIM(D.DEPT_CD) WHERE 1 = 1 AND (
1 = 1
1 = 0
OR B.BOARD_TYPE_CD IN ('FREE', 'ANON', 'NOTICE', 'DEPT') OR B.FRST_RGTR_ID = #{empId} OR TRIM(B.DEPT_CD) = TRIM(#{myDeptCd})
OR TRIM(B.DEPT_CD) IN
#{scopeDeptCd}
)

SELECT BOARD_ID ,BOARD_TYPE_CD ,BOARD_SJ ,BOARD_CN ,FRST_RGTR_ID ,FRST_REG_DT ,LAST_MDFR_DT ,BOARD_ATCH_FILE_ID ,DEPT_CD ,PROJ_ID ,IMPRTNT_YN ,CMNT_USE_YN ,VIEW_CNT FROM tb_board WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
SELECT COMMENT_ID, BOARD_ID, COMMENT_CN, WRTER_EMP_ID, WRTE_DT, COMMENT_PRT_ID, COMMENT_DEPTH, COMMENT_ORDER FROM TB_BOARD_COMMENT WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId} ORDER BY COMMENT_ORDER ASC, WRTE_DT ASC
SELECT BOARD_ID,EMP_ID,FRST_REG_DT FROM tb_board_like WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId} AND EMP_ID = #{empId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_board WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId}
AND ( BOARD_SJ LIKE '%' || #{searchRequest.keyword} || '%' OR BOARD_CN LIKE '%' || #{searchRequest.keyword} || '%' )

SELECT b.BOARD_ID, b.BOARD_TYPE_CD, b.BOARD_SJ, b.BOARD_CN, b.FRST_RGTR_ID, b.FRST_REG_DT, b.LAST_MDFR_DT, b.BOARD_ATCH_FILE_ID, b.DEPT_CD, b.IMPRTNT_YN, b.CMNT_USE_YN, b.VIEW_CNT, p.PROJ_ID, p.PROJ_NM, p.PROJ_STAT_CD FROM TB_BOARD b INNER JOIN TB_PROJECT p ON b.PROJ_ID = p.PROJ_ID WHERE p.PROJ_ID = #{projId} ORDER BY b.FRST_REG_DT DESC OFFSET #{getOffset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{getPageSize} ROWS ONLY
